description:
Ultimate X-Men #50 (October 2004), Marvel Comics - "Cry Wolf, Part 1." Written by Brian K. Vaughan, cover and art by Andy Kubert and Danny Miki. Direct edition, $2.25 cover price.

Back cover: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid movie ad.

Condition: a black marker mark on the front cover at the upper right, beside the "Cry Wolf: Part 1" text; otherwise bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
